capabilities: Move completed checkbox tasks with their sub-tasks under a Done heading
Move task blocks touched by the current text selection
Automatically move tasks to Done once checked and all sub-tasks are checked
Append a ✅ completion date to each moved line
Exclude folders or files from auto mode
extras: README includes privacy disclosures (offline, no telemetry) and manual install steps; a German-language page exists and the UI localizes to English/German.
problem: Completed checkbox tasks stay mixed in with open to-dos in a note, cluttering the list unless the user cuts and pastes them by hand.
summary: Task mover that relocates completed checkbox tasks, including sub-tasks, into a Done section of the same note, via menu, command, or automatically.
